newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 95,500 MT were 71 percent above the week earlier and 76 percent over the 4-week average. Japan (61,800 MT, doubling commitments for this marketing year) dominated the week's activity, with smaller sales to the Netherlands (7,700 MT), El Salvador (7,500 MT--all rough), South Africa (7,400 MT), Mexico (2,600 MT, of which 2,300 MT was rough), and Haiti (2,100 MT).
Exports of 24,400 MT were down 47 percent from the prior week and 40 percent below the 4-week average.
The major destinations were South Africa (4,400 MT), Saudi Arabia (3,700 MT), Mexico (2,800 MT), the Leeward and Windward Islands (2,700 MT), Trinidad (2,500 MT), and Haiti (2,100 MT).
